{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
df_loyal = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check the count of loyal customers
print(f'Number of loyal customers: {len(df_loyal)}')

# Check the number of converted orders among loyal customers
converted_loyal = df_loyal['converted'].sum()
print(f'Number of converted orders among loyal customers: {converted_loyal}')

# Compute the fraction
fraction_converted = converted_loyal / len(df_loyal)
print(f'Fraction converted among loyal customers: {fraction_converted}')"}
